bio: Jim Desmond is an American politician and retired aviator serving as a member of the San Diego County Board of Supervisors since 2019, representing the fifth district. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as vice chair of the board from 2020 to 2021, mayor of San Marcos, California from 2006 to 2018, and as a member of the San Marcos city council from 2004 to 2006.

items.t: Sided with the Trump administration in its 2018 lawsuit against California over Senate Bill 54, the state's sanctuary law.
items.q: Desmond sided with the Trump administration during a 2018 lawsuit against the state of California over its passage of Senate Bill 54, which made it a sanctuary state.

items.t: Voted no in December 2024 on a county resolution restricting San Diego County law enforcement from using county resources to cooperate with federal authorities, including ICE.
items.q: he voted against a resolution restricting law enforcement in San Diego County from using county resources to cooperate with federal authorities, including ICE.

items.t: Joined other Southern California Republicans in February 2025 at a press conference promoting a state senate bill to weaken California's sanctuary law, SB54.
items.q: Desmond attended a press conference with other Republicans from Southern California to promote a state senate bill that would weaken California's sanctuary law, SB54

items.t: Testified in 2024 before the House Committee on Homeland Security about the strain migrants have placed on San Diego County resources.
items.q: he testified before the Republican -led House Committee on Homeland Security, saying that an influx of migrants have placed a strain on San Diego County 's resources.

items.t: Said schools and the economy should be reopened safely during COVID-19.
items.q: arguing that schools and the economy should be reopened safely and that the dangers of the disease, particularly in schools, were exaggerated.

items.t: Sent letters in April 2025 to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Secretary of State Marco Rubio calling for federal action on the Tijuana River Valley sewage crisis.
items.q: Desmond sent letters to U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio demanding intervention in the Tijuana River Valley sewage crisis
